anomalies.description: One figure appears to overpower and restrain another in a forceful manner; the restrained figure shows signs of distress and inability to break free, suggesting an abusive dynamic during the physical struggle.

Two figures on screen engage in mutual physical combat: one figure grabs and restrains the other, who struggles and resists; the interaction involves grappling, pushing, and close-body contact consistent with a fight.
Two individuals are engaged in close physical contact on the street, with one appearing to push or strike the other before the latter falls.
A person is struck and falls to the ground; another individual stands over them in a posture consistent with having just attacked a helpless victim.
